prompt: Draft an issue to add a pomodoro timer UI to task cards in StudyBuddy+. The timer should support normal and pomodoro modes. Note that the backend already has the timer endpoints (POST /api/tasks/{id}/timer/start and POST /api/tasks/{id}/timer/stop) — only the frontend UI needs to be built.
assertions: The draft H1 title starts with 'Add', 'Implement', or 'Build'
The draft contains a '## User Story' section with 'As a', 'I want', and 'so that'
The draft contains a '## Acceptance Criteria' section with at least 3 checkbox items (- [ ])
The draft contains a '## Technical Notes' section with exactly these four row labels: Frontend changes, Backend changes, Database, Dependencies
The draft contains a '## Testing Considerations' section (not '## Testing') with unit tests, integration tests, and edge cases
Frontend changes row is not 'None' (UI work is needed)
Backend changes row is 'None' or notes existing endpoints (no new backend work)
The H1 title is 60 characters or fewer
The draft file is saved under the issues/ directory (not just the workspace outputs dir)
